Dear Madam
I beg to acknowledge the receipt of your cheque.
I think that as your money is invested & producing interest you may as well wait until a short time before 1 April & then give your Bankers instructions to sell sufficient to produce £1000, so that it may be ready a day or two before the 1st[^1]
I am yours faithy
[Chas Wooldridge](/person/2094)
Miss Yonge


[^1]: This relates to CMY’s plan to pay off the mortgage on an insurance policy held with the Norwich Union on the life of her sister-in-law [Emma Frances Yonge](/person/1604). CMY had been paying both the interest on the mortgage and the premiums on the life policy.
